description: List the registered temporary-access targets — the databases (Postgres, MySQL, …) against which short-lived credentials can be minted on demand instead of storing a standing password. Use it to see what can be leased before minting one (create_pg_lease / create_mysql_lease run on the LOCAL crypto plane), and see list_leases for what has actually been issued. Returns [{ id, orgId, provider, name, config, createdAt }], where `provider` names the kind of target (postgres, mysql, …) and `config` is non-secret connection settings.

org.description: Organization slug or id. Omit it when the credential can reach exactly one org — that org is used automatically. With several, the error names every slug you may pass; list them yourself with list_orgs.

name: list_lease_targets
